name: Night Sentinel
detailed_description:
🕯️ Night Sentinel – Your Shift Starts Now.

When night falls, the real nightmare begins inside the Dunkberg Museum of Natural History.
You are Finn or Stella – one of two newly hired night guards, ready to face the eerie shadows that move between the exhibits.

At first, everything seems calm. Your duties? Routine patrols, sorting deliveries, monitoring security cameras. But something is wrong. Objects go missing. Statues shift. And something… is watching you.

Supernatural anomalies haunt the seemingly quiet halls – and it’s your job to identify and decontaminate them before they spiral out of control. Sometimes it’s just a flickering light. Sometimes... something far more disturbing.

But this is only the beginning. The deeper you go into the museum’s nightly rhythm, the more you uncover a buried, ancient secret.
Your actions and decisions shape the story – and determine which of the many possible endings awaits you.

🧩 Features:

  • Horror adventure with co-op mode – Play solo or team up in two-player co-op to face the dangers of the night.

  • Creepy nightly routines – Patrol checkpoints, unload deliveries, monitor cameras… and deal with the unexplainable in between.

  • Detect and decontaminate anomalies – Use specialized tools to neutralize paranormal disturbances.

  • Branching narrative – Your choices matter. Experience multiple paths and endings based on how you respond to the night.

  • Atmospheric setting – Explore a richly detailed museum filled with secrets, shadows, and stories that whisper from the dark.

Ready for your first night shift?
“Night Sentinel” isn’t just a job – it’s a game of reality.
And maybe… reality plays back.

short_description: Take the night shift as a museum guard in “Night Sentinel”. Complete tasks, investigate anomalies, and survive the growing horrors within. Play solo or co-op and uncover a dark mystery with multiple endings.
supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German*, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT / NVIDIA RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of supernatural threats, psychological horror, jump scares, and violent encounters with monsters and intruders.
Blood is present in a moderate form. The atmosphere is dark and may be disturbing to sensitive players.
Not suitable for children or those easily disturbed.
